analytics-legacy: Ebipimo tebiriwo ku lipoota eno. Ddamu oteekeko demo okukola okwekenneenya okw'omu kiseera kino.
analytics-partial: Ebipimo ebimu birina ebikwata ku muzannyo ebitono okuva ku nsibuko
award-unavailable-pool: Tewali muzannyi yalondeddwa mu kibinja ekiriwo ekyabaliddwa.
comparison-note: Geraageranya abazannyi ku kipimo kye kimu. Ebipimo ebibulamu tebibalibwa.
grenade-note: Obuvune obwawandiikibwa obwatuusibwa ku mulabe ne bbomu za HE n'omuliro. Ebipimo ebibulamu ku nsibuko bisigala nga tebiriwo.
metric-definitions-rating: ADR ye bulabe obwa wakati mu buli round ekakasiddwa. KAST ye bitundu ku kikumi eby’enround ezirimu kill, assist, okusigala nga mulamu oba trade. Okupima okutalina yuniti kwa kugezesa era tekunnapimibwa bulungi, era tekugamba nti obulabe bwakolebwa bugenderevu.
metrics-advantage: Okutta ng'abalamu bo bangi okusinga abalabe
metrics-clutch-note: Obuwanguzi bwa clutch buva mu kufa okwakwatibwa ne mu buwanguzi bw'enzannya. Obujjuvu bw'amawulire g'okusigala omulamu ne clutch businziira ku mawulire g'okwetabamu agaliwo. Akasaze kategeeza nti tewali mawulire, si ziro.
metrics-disadvantage: Okutta ng'abalamu bo batono ku balabe
metrics-equipment: Omuwendo gw'ebikozesebwa mu biwandiiko by'obudde bw'okwetegeka
metrics-harm-note: Ebikolwa ebyakwatibwa tebikakasa kigendererwa. Okufa okwa bulijjo n'okufa okutaddizibwamu okutta omulabe mazima agakwata ku byabaddewo, si nsobi ku bwabyo.
metrics-trade-participation: Okwetaba mu kuddamu okutta omulabe asse munno
metrics-trades: Okulwana okusooka n'okuddamu okutta omulabe asse munno
moments-rating-note: Tewali kyabaddewo kiragibwa ng’ekitundu ky’okupima okukola.
mvp-caption-rating: Okupima okusinga okulungi okubaliddwa mu mupiira
no-teams: Tewali lukalala lwa bazannyi ba timu olukakasiddwa.
rating-absent: Omuzannyi teyabaddewo mu round nnyingi nnyo ezikakasiddwa
rating-noncausal: Enamba eno etannapimibwa bulungi ennyonnyola okwetaba okupimiddwa. Si bukakafu bwa musango gwa taktiki oba kigendererwa.
replay-accuracy-note: Ebifo biva mu bifaananyi bya demo; ebifaananyi ebikakasiddwa era ebiddiringana byokka bye biyungibwa obulungi. Eno si vidiyo entuufu ku buli fuleemu.
replay-canvas-label: Okulaba okuva waggulu ebifo by’abazannyi mu raundi erondeddwa
replay-map-level-note: Abazannyi bokka abamanyiddwa obugulumivu bwabwe ku lukato luno be balagibwa.
replay-map-unsupported-note: Ebifo ebiterekeddwa tebiragibwa awatali kukakasa bipimo bya maapu.
replay-map-version-note: Rada eva mu lukalala lwa maapu ezirina enkyusa eziterekeddwa. Obutambi bw’emizannyo obukadde buyinza okuba n’entegeka ya maapu ey’enjawulo.
replay-partial: Ebifaananyi ebimu eby’ebifo tebiriwo. Ebituli tebiteeberezebwa.
replay-unavailable-note: Omupiira guno gwakolebwa nga ebifo tebinnaterekebwa. Entambula teteeberezebwa okuva mu bibalo.
who-ruined-caption: Okupima okusinga wansi okubaliddwa mu lukalala olwakubiddwa
who-ruined-draw-caption: Okupima okusinga wansi okubaliddwa mu kibinja ky’omupiira ogw’enkanankana
